name: Giotail
source:
One day, Shou, an ordinary high school student, is taken to another world. Another world.... It is completely the same as the world he belonged to a while ago. Same scenery, same students at school..., and Shou is there, as well. It seems the school is in danger now due to monsters that kidnap the students. Why was he taken to another world? Are there any reasons? Shou sets out on adventure with his classmates to solve mysteries....

translation:
某天，普通高中生翔被带到了另一个世界。另一个世界……那里与他片刻前所在的世界完全相同。同样的景色、同样的学校与学生……甚至那里也有一个翔。如今，学校似乎正因绑架学生的怪物而陷入危机。他为什么会被带到另一个世界？其中有什么原因吗？翔与同班同学踏上冒险，开始解开谜团……
